statement: Let X be a smooth simple compact Kähler manifold of dimension n ≥ 2, with a(X) = 0 and irregularity zero. Assume that the only positive-dimensional proper compact irreducible analytic subvarieties through a very general point of X2 are its factor slices. Let L be a holomorphic line bundle with pseudo-effective class L. Assume the following line-subsheaf bounds: 1. For every line bundle H , every integer k ≥ 0, and every nonzero map H → Ω⊗k X , one has c1(H ) ≤ kL. 21 2. Outside a countable union of proper analytic subsets of X, every point x has this property: if a : Y = Blx X → X, then for every line bundle HY , every k ≥ 0, and every nonzero map HY → (a∗ΩX)⊗k, one has c1(HY ) ≤ ka∗L. Then some positive power of L has a nonzero meromorphic section.
